title.narrative: Educational Infrastructure Improvement in Mayo Locality - Khartoum

description.narrative:
This flagship project for Caritas Sudan in Khartoum aims to promote quality education for children living in Mayo locality, a suburb of Khartoum where most low-income earners and refugees live. The Church is well known for its capacity in the education sector, usually providing such services in poor communities for Vulnerable children, teenagers, and adults. To fulfil its mission amidst the unique socio-economic situation in Sudan and given the church’s positioning, Caritas Sudan has decided to take the lead to engage partners to advocate and seek support to address the current challenges faced in the two schools in Mayo locality, Boys Model Education Centre, and Our Lady of Hope Girls primary schools.
Project Goal Enhance access to quality education and the welfare of vulnerable pupils in Mayo locality.
Project Objectives Improve the learning and hygiene conditions in the targeted schools to create a conducive learning environment for the pupils. Create a conducive working environment to boost the teacher’s morale to provide the needed education and skills to the pupils. Empower the PTA members to facilitate having a functional Association aware of its roles and effectively participating in the management of the schools. Improved financial sustainability for the schools.
INTERVENTION STRATEGY Infrastructure Renovations Provision of Learning Aids and Equipment Capacity Building of the PTA members and Untrained Teachers Establish a School Income Generation Project;
